Method of Attack: Cryptomining dropper malware that gains persistence on Linux hosts by adding cron jobs to reinfect compromised machines after removal
Downloads cryptominer payload using Bash script
Kills other cryptomining processes such as xmrig and cryptonight
Downloads payload and configuration from attacker-controlled server
Spawns cryptominer process using nohup to keep running after bash session ends
Deletes payload and config files after loading miner in memory to hide presence
Creates cron job running every minute to check and re-download cr2.sh if missing, enabling automatic reinfection
Impacted Systems: Linux hosts (web servers and desktop installations of 32/64bit Linux systems)
Attack Vector: Unknown initial infection method, possibly exploiting unpatched vulnerabilities, brute forcing, or phishing admin credentials
